title: AFV Fibers
intro: Six whole-scan fiber sets as public Hugging Face datasets, each a few .afv files (read-only SQLite) plus small per-cell tiles, logged out; the scans they came from are open data, read live. The page is also an API and an MCP server that returns the fibers in any box.

sources.title: Fibers of one 1024-voxel cell of PHerc0139 (178 MB; the whole-scan files PHerc0139_afv_v2.afv and PHerc0139_afv_v2_1mm.afv, and the other five scans, have the same format)
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (derived from Vesuvius Challenge open data); model and generator Apache 2.0
sources.note: Model output (Qualzz20/afv_fiber_9um_v2, AVF_SPLINE_GENERATOR). Native level-0 voxels, XYZ float64, VC3D fiber collection version 1; open with Python's sqlite3 or villa's import_afv.py.

sources.title: The tile index: one small .afv per 1024-voxel cell, for any box without the whole file
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (derived from Vesuvius Challenge open data)
sources.note: Each entry gives the cell's box_zyx_l0 (level-0 voxels) and fiber count; tiles/<id>.afv holds every fiber with a block in that cell, whole, with its whole-scan id.

sources.title: X-ray CT those fibers came from, PHerc0139 9.362 um
sources.note: Read live from the open-data bucket, never copied here. The fibers' level-0 voxels are this scan's level 0.

sources.title: Fibers in any box, from code or an agent
sources.note: fibers_box(scan, z, y, x, half) lists every fiber touching a box; look(...) adds the CT picture, a 3D view and the box as .afv. Model output, not a reading.
